lines.en: I drag my body across the marsh.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在决定方向
lines.en: Each step feels like a decision.

lines.zh: 我的皮上覆着层层旧壳
lines.en: Old shells layer over my hide.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方地势变了
lines.en: The land changes where I walk.

lines.zh: 体内的时间走得比外面慢
lines.en: Time runs slower inside me than outside.

lines.zh: 我不急,我已经等了很久
lines.en: I am unhurried; I have waited long.
My bone spurs scrape the trunks.

lines.zh: 我朝有生命的地方移动
lines.en: I move toward wherever life is.
Water pools in the furrow I leave.

lines.zh: 我一步一步,不停也不快
lines.en: Step by step, neither fast nor stopping.

lines.zh: 我站着,像座会呼吸的丘
lines.en: I stand like a breathing mound.

lines.zh: 旧壳在我背上又厚了一层
lines.en: Another layer of shell has set on my back.
I listen to the tide inside me.

lines.zh: 这片地已经被我踩熟了
lines.en: This ground is worn familiar under me.
My breath makes the grass rise and fall.
Seawater seeps between my bone spurs.
I turn my head toward the sound.
I have not moved for a long while.
A ring of dead grass circles my feet.

lines.zh: 体内的东西在缓慢生长
lines.en: Something inside me grows, slowly.
I lift a forelimb, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这具身体记得每一次战斗
lines.en: This body remembers every fight.
The water shows my outline.
I have outlived another span.
The tide-sound never stops at my ear.

lines.zh: 活着本身就是一种延长
lines.en: Living is itself a kind of prolonging.

lines.zh: 你比上次来的那个更小
lines.en: You are smaller than the last one.
I lower my head and take you in.
Your heart is beating fast.
Another layer of soil has settled on my old shell
Your scent is new to me.
I raise a bone spur, then withdraw it.
We do not have to fight.
You tremble inside my shadow.
I tilt my head as if waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 这片地归我,但我允许你站着
lines.en: This ground is mine, but you may stand.
I have not heard a voice in ages.
Speak; I am listening.
An old shell has cracked.

lines.zh: 我没有退,只是停了一下
lines.en: I did not retreat; I merely paused.

lines.zh: 这一点伤,我受过更重的
lines.en: I have taken worse than this.
Something inside me has been disturbed.
I turn slowly.
Your force surprised me.
The crack in my shell is closing over.
You are still far short of me.
I plant myself even firmer.
My time is still long.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的旧壳发痒
lines.en: That smell makes my old shell itch.
I move slowly toward you.
A hunger I had forgotten stirs.
I extend a limb of bone.
What you hold is far too small.
The ground sounds as I near.

lines.zh: 我已很久没有尝到活物
lines.en: I have not tasted anything living in ages.
Do not put it away.
I shift one more step forward.
This hunger is slow, but it does not stop.

lines.zh: 你撞上来,我连晃都没晃
lines.en: You strike, and I do not even sway.
My shell is harder than your bones.
You are driven back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一下在我皮上没留痕
lines.en: That left no mark on my hide.
Do not stand leaning on my shell.
I slowly turn one flank.
My weight pushes you aside.
The ground gives under me.
Collisions barely register with me.
Get out of my way.

lines.zh: 我们这样的东西,活得够久
lines.en: Creatures like us live long enough.
I lower my bulk toward you.

lines.zh: 时间在我们身上流得很慢
lines.en: Time moves slowly through us.

lines.zh: 我们的壳会长在一起吗
lines.en: Will our shells grow together?
I have waited here a long time for you.
The tide rises and falls; we remain.
I offer you one bone spur.
Just stand with me.
Nothing needs to be said.
Stay with me a little longer.
I pinch it up between joints.
This will rot if left.
I store it inside my body.
It seems to shrink in my grasp.

lines.zh: 我需要它,或者说我必须
lines.en: I need it, or rather I must.
This is not from the sea.
I draw my long limb shut.
Slowly; there is no hurry.
I tuck it beneath my shell.
I will keep it for now.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味被我记住了
lines.en: I have fixed your scent.
I have lived too long to be moved.

lines.zh: 你动手的那一刻,我就知道了
lines.en: I knew the instant you moved.
Another mark for my shell.
I lower my head slowly.
You chose me; that takes courage.
Two hundred years of patience.

lines.zh: 四格高的身子，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: Four blocks tall, I move slowly.
You stand on my path.

lines.zh: 这片地被我的影子盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers this ground.

lines.zh: 你跑的方向，正是我的巢
lines.en: The way you run leads straight to my nest
You will be the first to tire.
The tide inside me is rising.
My shell seams open and the tide roars in
I will remember this fight.
No one has dared this in a long while.
I raise a forelimb, slowly.
It comes down fast.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步慢慢转
lines.en: I turn slowly with your steps.
Every bone spine is raised.

lines.zh: 我在这片地上等了太久
lines.en: I have waited too long on this ground.

lines.zh: 你每绕一圈,我就收一寸
lines.en: Each circle you make, I close an inch.
Every bone spur has risen.
Time inside me is quickening.

lines.zh: 潮水在你脚后跟追上来了
lines.en: The tide has caught up to your heels

lines.zh: 我压低身体,像要压塌地面
lines.en: I settle low, as if to crush the ground.
Do you hear the shell creaking?
I need not hurry; you will tire.
The tide advances with me.

lines.zh: 这片林子的树我在一棵棵推倒
lines.en: I am pushing the trees down one by one.
Your breathing grows heavier.
I have the distance measured.
One step more and you enter my ground.
I open a seam in my shell, slowly.
The sea waits below.
You will not get the chance to turn.
I raise my limb and aim at you.
I have saved this blow for decades.
The bone spur comes down from above.
I press down, and the ground caves.
You are knocked rolling away.

lines.zh: 这一击带着几十年的重量
lines.en: This blow carries decades of weight.
My long limb sweeps through you.
An old wound in my shell splits again.
You are still standing; good.
I step back and reset my stance.
The tide thins the blood.
I raise a second limb.
This one goes deeper.
Do not mistake slowness for weakness.
There is a tree behind you.
I advance one slow step more.
The old shell breaks the soil first.
I sit up out of the sediment.
Seawater runs down the slope.

lines.zh: 我的躯体一节一节撑起
lines.en: My body rises, section by section.
I press this ground lower first.
The soil splits, and the bone spikes show first
Bone spurs rise along my back.
I open my eyes; there is no light in them.

lines.zh: 沉积了太久的身体很重
lines.en: A body long buried is heavy.
I lift my first foot.
The trees look thin beside me.
The seaborn's prolonging begins.
I smell living things here.
I have waited long for this moment.
Soil slides off my back.
I straighten, and the whole wood creaks.
The tide is coming in.
I will prolong this road.
You are all standing too close.
Then let it start here.
My old shell crackles in the heat.

lines.zh: 我这么重,砸下去起不来
lines.en: So heavy, I cannot rise from the fall.
Seawater should have been my home.
My shell is blown apart.
Something lodges in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的时间乱了
lines.en: That force tangles my sense of time.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿开始吞我自己
lines.en: My hunger has begun to eat me.
Lightning crawls along my bone spurs.
Even time does not flow here.
